You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in #inc-vtg-hartford. Your message said both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan, and the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

I replied in the channel with that timeline. Mateo reported six trucks waiting at 10:44, Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 with trailer 8836 checked in, and you noted both lanes working at 11:07.
